name: Tsukune-chan no Daibouken Dotou no Karimenkyo Hen
original_name: つくねちゃんの大冒険 怒涛の仮免許編
source:
Tsukune is a 16-year old girl who works as a witch's apprentice. Today is the test day for becoming a witch and she forgot her magic pants!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-june-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
